description:
About the job

About Kennedy University

Kennedy University of Leadership, is an innovative, fast paced, global online university, based in the United States. The university has staff and students around the world, with a passion for applied, relevant career enhancing education.




Role overview

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Head of Marketing in Los Angeles

Location: Mexico City, remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: USD $2,500/month




This role sits inside the Kennedy University marketing department. You will work directly with the marketing team to produce content across social media, video, email, graphic design, and our website.

This is a creative execution role for someone who does not wait to be told. You will bring ideas, spot gaps, and push the work further than the brief asked for. You move fast, stay on-brand, and treat every asset, whether it is a 30-second reel or a brochure with brand integrity. 




English language and communications skills must be excellent and are essential.




What you will be doing

Video and content creation

- Editing short-form video content - 30-second cuts, social reels, and student story features

- Filming and interviewing students via Zoom, capturing story content for video and social - up to 10 sessions per week

- Adding logo overlays and motion treatments to video content

- Producing video assets that are polished, on-brand, and ready to publish

Graphic design and marketing collateral

- Designing flyers, brochures, social posts, email headers, and promotional materials in Canva

- Using Canva AI features to accelerate production without sacrificing quality

- Maintaining strict brand guideline accuracy across every asset

- Supporting the marketing team with design requests across campaigns and student communications

Email marketing

- Building and sending HTML email campaigns via HubSpot Marketing Suite

- Designing email templates that are clean, responsive, and on-brand

- Managing campaign scheduling and basic performance tracking

Social media

- Managing and scheduling content across Ducere social media platforms

- Supporting marketing campaign launches with creative assets and copy

- Monitoring engagement and flagging content opportunities to the team

Website

- Making content updates and edits to the Ducere website via WordPress

- Uploading assets, updating pages, and keeping content current and accurate

- Basic layout adjustments and formatting within the CMS




What we are looking for

Must have

- Solid video editing skills - short-form, social-first content

- Confident with Canva, including AI-assisted features

- Graphic design skills - flyers, brochures, and digital collateral

- Experience with HubSpot or a comparable email marketing platform

- Working knowledge of HTML for email templates

- Comfortable working in WordPress - editing pages and uploading content

- Strong attention to detail - brand accuracy is non-negotiable

- A proactive self-starter who brings creative ideas without being prompted

- Confident on camera and comfortable interviewing people via Zoom

- Clear communicator in English and Spanish

- Analytical mindset - you look at what is working and act on it

Nice to have

Experience with motion graphics or logo animation
Social media analytics and reporting
Prior experience at an education, or media brand
AI Tools and Automation experience

title: Meta / Google / TikTok Ads Specialist
description:
About the job

Job Description:

We are seeking a performance-driven Paid Media Specialist to manage and scale paid acquisition for a fast-growing U.S.-based direct-to-consumer eCommerce business. The ideal candidate has recent experience managing advertising for U.S. brands and a proven ability to optimize campaigns that drive revenue, customer acquisition, and profitable growth.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Develop, launch and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta and TikTok Ads.

• Build audience strategies including prospecting, retargeting and lookalikes.

• Execute creative, copy and landing page A/B tests.

• Monitor budgets and maximize ROAS.

• Implement and maintain accurate conversion tracking using GA4, GTM and Meta Pixel.

• Analyze performance and deliver actionable insights.

• Partner with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign performance.

• Stay current on platform updates and industry best practices.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Minimum 2 years of recent experience managing paid media for U.S.-based companies (mandatory).

• Experience with U.S. eCommerce consumer brands (mandatory).

• Advanced experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager.

• Strong knowledge of GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.

• Experience managing performance budgets and optimizing ROAS, CPA and CAC.

• Excellent analytical skills and English communication.




Preferred Skills:

• Shopify experience.

• Experience with Klaviyo or similar email marketing platforms.

• Knowledge of CRO and attribution models.

• Familiarity with creative testing frameworks for DTC brands.




Schedule:

Full-Time

Monday-Friday

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PT




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Being part of the Marketing team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest-growing companies ever. Be prepared for a hectic, fast-paced, and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi's growth in Mexico!

In this role, you'll be...


A creative, analytical, and motivated person who wants to begin a career in the Marketing team.
Providing significant support to the Marketing Manager in the Marketing Daily User Campaigns, Analytics, and Reporting. 
Deep diving into customer service interactions to identify qualitative insights and improvement opportunities.
Supporting market research and A/B tests to identify opportunities.
Benchmarking analysis and reporting, highlighting relevant insights. 
Supporting Marketing campaigns impacting traffic, growth, and engagement.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Students of bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Administration or Business. 
Fluent in English and Spanish.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Knowledge and interest in data analysis applied to business and marketing.
Deeper interest in Marketing Strategy. 
Interest in a hands-on team player role, as well as a self-driven way of working.
Creative and analytical thinking. 
Decision-making based on data and insights.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Specialist, you will execute and optimize Paid Search and Shopping campaigns to drive efficient client growth. You’ll build high‑quality account structures, translate performance data into clear next actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights under guidance to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, partner across your Pod (Channel SMEs, Analytics, Creative, Client Leads, Product/Bliss Point), and continuously document and improve your workflows. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.

Product‑Led


Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.

Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.

Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.


KPIs


Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.

description:
About the job

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Position Title: Consumer Digital Ecosystem Senior Associate

Job Level: P2 Location: Mexico

Supervisor: Joseba Barriola Potts

Consumer Digital Ecosystem is a core commercial role within the Eli Lilly Mexico Affiliate, built to translate multi-sourced data (B2B, Consumer, Marketing, and more) into prioritized commercial decisions that drive resource allocation, field execution, and consumer strategies. The position owns the full data consumption-analysis-transformation cycle and works with internal partners (brand teams, commercial teams, global teams, subject matter experts) as well as external partners (technology vendors, digital agencies, telehealth providers, e-commerce platforms) to build and scale consumer-facing digital capabilities that directly unlock new revenue channels and strengthen direct-to-patient relationships.

The Senior Associate needs deep understanding of digital ecosystems, commercial data, and consumer behavior to couple data-driven insights with business strategy and execute high-impact digital initiatives. The Senior Associate demonstrates an innate drive to innovate, a bias for action, and the ability to create seamless consumer experiences that optimize sell-through and build lasting patient relationships.

The Position

We are seeking a data-savvy, digitally-fluent, and strategically-minded individual to join our team as a Consumer Digital Ecosystem Senior Associate. In this role, you will own everything related to the digital ecosystem that directly impacts the consumer and the business — from e-commerce and telehealth to direct-to-consumer selling models and consumer digital journeys. You will be the single dedicated resource accountable for translating data into commercial decisions that optimize digital revenue channels, enhance patient relationships, and drive sell-through across an optimized digital experience.

As a Consumer Digital Ecosystem Senior Associate, your main responsibilities will be to:


Implement a comprehensive E-Commerce strategy: design, launch, and continuously optimize Lilly’s e-commerce capabilities to drive product accessibility, sell-through, and revenue growth through digital retail channels.
Launch a telehealth solution embedded in Lilly.com: lead end-to-end implementation of a telehealth capability integrated within Lilly’s digital ecosystem to extend the reach of care, facilitate patient-physician connections, and enhance the direct-to-patient value proposition.
Build and own a clear Consumer Digital Journey: map, design, and continuously improve the end-to-end digital experience for consumers, ensuring seamless interactions across all digital touchpoints from awareness to purchase and adherence.
Own the data consumption-analysis-transformation cycle: integrate and synthesize multi-sourced data (B2B, consumer, marketing, etc.) to generate actionable commercial insights, prioritize resource allocation, and inform field and consumer strategies.
Drive commercial decision-making through digital performance analytics: monitor key digital and commercial metrics (e-commerce conversion, telehealth adoption, digital journey KPIs) and adjust strategies to maximize business impact.
Lead cross-functional collaboration: partner with brand teams, commercial operations, IT, regulatory, medical affairs, and external vendors to align the digital ecosystem strategy with broader business and compliance priorities.
Manage and scale external digital partnerships: identify and cultivate relationships with technology partners, digital health start-ups, e-commerce platforms, and telehealth providers to continuously enhance Lilly’s digital consumer ecosystem.
Support brand teams in integrating digital ecosystem capabilities into their brand strategies, including identification of digital consumer segments, definition of digital-specific Critical Success Factors, and design of brand-level digital journeys.
Stay ahead of digital trends and innovation: continuously scan the competitive and technology landscape to identify emerging digital capabilities, tools, and models that can be adopted to maintain Lilly’s leadership in consumer-facing digital excellence.



Qualifications

About You


At least 3 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, commercial strategy, or digital ecosystem management, with a proven track record of driving business results through digital channels.
Hands-on experience managing e-commerce platforms, telehealth solutions, or direct-to-consumer digital channels, including ownership of key digital performance metrics (conversion rates, digital funnel KPIs).
Demonstrated ability to synthesize multi-source data (B2B, consumer, commercial, marketing) into actionable insights and prioritized business decisions, with experience in data analytics tools and dashboarding.
Experience leading multi-layered projects in cross-functional and cross-national environments, including collaboration with IT, medical affairs, regulatory, and external technology vendors.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of how digital channels (e-commerce, telehealth, direct-to-patient) translate into revenue impact and resource allocation decisions.
Strong English skills to collaborate effectively with global counterparts and multinational stakeholders. Spanish proficiency required.
Deep understanding of the digital and multi-channel marketing landscape, including SFE models, CRM tools, marketing automation platforms, and consumer journey analytics. Experience with digital media execution and paid digital strategies.
Solid project management skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage vendors and external partners, and deliver results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.



Location: Mexico

Additional Information


Some travel is possible, up to 5-15%

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

About the job

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

Design and implement initiatives to acquire new drivers, being able to leverage data for the decision making process.

Ownership of driver acquisition incentives, across multiple countries in Spanish Speaking LatAm.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The successful applicant:


Bachelor's Degree: Engineering, Data Science, Actuary or any related field.
Growth / Marketplace experience: Experimental Testing, User Acquisition, Conversion, Habit Loops, PMF, GTM, Communication Strategies, Marketplace Balance, Pricing, etc

Data-driven core: passion for data analytics and programming, with knowledge/experience in SQL (Nice to have: Python, R, etc.). Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets) are a must. Comfortable about learning and using new software tools.
Effective communication skills. Proficiency in English & Spanish. We're an international team!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

description:
About the job

Marketing Recruiter (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary: $800 to $1,300 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.




You should genuinely enjoy talking to people, evaluating talent, improving recruiting systems, and building relationships with candidates. You care about quality over quantity and believe that hiring one outstanding person beats hiring 10 average ones.




As our company grows, you'll also help improve our recruiting systems, employer branding, onboarding experience, company culture and talent pipelines so hiring becomes faster, smarter, and more scalable.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Present hiring managers with highly qualified candidates instead of large numbers of average applicants.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.
Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.
Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.
Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.
Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.
Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.
Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.
Partner closely with leadership to understand hiring priorities and proactively recommend improvements.




What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.
Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.
Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.
Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.
Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.
Conduct structured interviews.
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
Perform reference checks when appropriate.
Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.
Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.




2) Candidate Evaluation

Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.
Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.
Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.
Build structured interview scorecards for every role.
Develop role-specific interview questions.
Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.




3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

Build and improve recruiting workflows.
Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.
Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.
Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.
Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.
Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.




4) Partnership With Leadership

Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.
Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.
Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.
Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.
Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.




5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.
Write engaging candidate outreach messages.
Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.
Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.




6) Onboarding Support

Coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires.
Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.
Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.




7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional Projects

When recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

Supporting HR and administrative tasks when needed.
Helping organize company documents, processes, and SOPs.
Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.
Helping with company culture, team engagement, and employee experience initiatives.
Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.




This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.




What We're Looking For

Preferred:

Experience recruiting for roles such as:
E-commerce Shopify DTC Marketing
Paid Media
Creative Strategy
Video Editing
Email Marketing
SMS Marketing
Affiliate Marketing
Influencer Marketing
Wholesale Sales

Experience working with remote international teams is a strong plus.




Must-haves:

2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.
Experience recruiting digital marketing, creative, e-commerce, or startup positions.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.
Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.
Exceptional organization and follow-through.
Strong ownership mindset, you proactively solve problems instead of waiting for direction.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Must have a growth mindset, developing your skills and solving hardest problems. 




Nice to have:

LinkedIn Recruiter
Indeed
OnlineJobs.ph
Google Workspace
Asana
AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
Startup or e-commerce experience
Experience building recruiting scorecards, interview guides, assessments, or hiring SOPs




What You Get:

$800 to $1,300 USD per month plus performance bonuses based on experience.
Fully remote role with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern.
Direct collaboration with leadership and the Founder.
Significant opportunities for career growth as TopFoxx continues to scale.
A supportive, ambitious, and collaborative team environment.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off.




How to Apply:

Send us your resume to recruiting@topfoxx.com along with a short response answering the following question: Tell us about the most difficult role you've ever recruited for. What made it challenging, how did you approach the search, and what was the final outcome?




We'd also love to know why recruiting marketing and creative talent excites you, and what you think separates an exceptional candidate from an average one.




If you're passionate about building outstanding teams and helping a growing company find incredible people, we'd love to hear from you.

Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

About The Company

Our client operates a leading global marketplace that connects high-growth startups and scale-ups with rigorously vetted software engineering talent. By specializing in the rapid placement of senior-level developers, the team helps innovative companies worldwide accelerate their product roadmaps, launch MVPs, and stabilize technical infrastructure. Their platform supports a vast array of technologies, including AI, blockchain, and full-stack web development, ensuring that businesses can scale their engineering capacity with month-to-month flexibility and precision-matched expertise.

Driven by a commitment to quality over automation, the company employs a human-centric vetting process to identify the top 1% of technical talent across Europe, LatAm, and the US. As a fast-growing player in the HR-tech and talent acquisition space, they offer an environment where efficiency and innovation intersect, helping partners bridge the global skill gap while providing developers with opportunities to work on cutting-edge international projects.

You will be responsible for building direct relationships with Tier-1 tech journalists, ghostwriting for our executive team, and scaling our Share of Voice across North America and Europe. This is a role for a hands-on executor who thrives in a lean startup environment and knows exactly how to get a story picked up by TechCrunch or Forbes through sheer grit and creative pitching.

title: Salesperson
description:
About the job

Remote Closer (Mexico). Inbound Calls Only. $40,000 to $72,000+ USD We're hiring 3 to 4.


What this is: Authorify is a 17-year-old US company that helps American real estate agents win listings with published books. Our webinar funnel puts 5 to 6 booked appointments a day on your calendar. No cold calls and no lead hunting. You show up on Zoom and close annual memberships that average $3,000 USD, mostly paid in full on the call.




What it pays: $2,000 USD a month guaranteed for your first 60 days while you ramp up. After that, $1,000 a month base plus a 6% commission on the cash you collect on paid-in-full sales, moving up to 8% when you convert higher. When you convert 20 of every 100 booked meetings into sales and collect $30,000 or more, you make the higher commission. Payment plans and discounts pay a lower commission percentage (4%), and we tell you that here because we would rather you know everything now than be surprised later. Add a monthly contest and a weekly prize wheel on top of your regular commissions. Realistically, in your first year you should make $40,000 to $50,000 USD, and strong closers track $70,000 and up. We will show our sales teams numbers in the interview.




What it's like to work here: we hold a daily role-play huddle, one proven script that converts about 30% for our best closer, and every call is recorded and scored by AI, both to coach you and to make sure every customer hears the same offer. If you want to freelance your own sales process, this is not your team. If you want a machine that feeds you and coaching that sharpens you, it is.




Who should apply: You should apply if you have 2 or more years of closing high-ticket phone or Zoom sales in fluent English, with verifiable numbers, and are available during US Eastern hours. Mexico City or Guadalajara preferred, but anywhere in Mexico or LATAM will be considered.




How our hiring process works: Apply, and if you are qualified, we will email you a short script within one business day. We will provide easy-to-follow instructions so you can record a 60-second video of yourself delivering the script in English and send it back within 48 hours. No video, no interview. Good videos get scheduled for an interview within one business day. If we like each other, we can have you hired within a week. We move at a closer speed.

description:
About the job

Fractional Growth Marketer — Fintech & SaaS

Contract Opportunity | 20 Hours per Week | Remote

Hourly Rate: $28–$42 USD, based on experience







About ATQLeads

ATQLeads is a U.S.-based Go-to-Market execution company that helps organizations design, build, and operate scalable growth systems.

We combine strategy, technology, AI-enabled workflows, and specialized GTM talent to help our clients execute across demand generation, marketing operations, sales development, automation, and revenue growth.




Through the ATQ Certified Operator Network, we identify, evaluate, and deploy experienced GTM professionals into client engagements based on their expertise, industry experience, technical capabilities, availability, and fit for each mission.




Operators in the network may receive access to ongoing client opportunities, ATQ training and certification programs, performance coaching, community support, and potential pathways into longer-term or full-time roles.







The Opportunity

ATQLeads is seeking an experienced Fractional Growth Marketer to support a U.S.-based SaaS company serving the financial services industry.




This is a remote contract engagement requiring approximately 20 hours per week.

The ideal candidate has experience developing and managing multi-channel growth campaigns for B2B SaaS companies, particularly those selling to:

Banks
Credit unions
Financial institutions
Financial services executives
Enterprise and mid-market buying committees




You will be responsible for connecting campaign strategy, messaging, content, nurture, paid media, webinars, landing pages, and performance insights into one coordinated growth system.




This is not a role focused only on producing marketing assets. You will be expected to understand the complete acquisition funnel, identify conversion opportunities, run structured experiments, and continuously improve campaign performance.







Key Responsibilities







Campaign Strategy and Messaging

Own the messaging angle and creative strategy for active campaigns.

Every campaign should launch with:

A clear growth hypothesis
A defined target audience
A relevant value proposition
A coordinated campaign message
Measurable conversion objectives




You will continuously refine messaging based on campaign data, market feedback, and audience engagement.







A/B Testing and Conversion Optimization

Develop and manage an ongoing experimentation program across active campaigns.

You will test elements including:

Subject lines
Value propositions
Calls to action
Creative concepts
Landing-page copy
Audience segments
Campaign offers
Nurture messaging




Winning variants should be documented, applied across channels, and scaled.







Funnel Audit and Ongoing Optimization

Begin the engagement by conducting a complete audit of the existing marketing and sales funnel.

Map conversion performance across the buyer journey, including:

First touch
Content engagement
Landing-page conversion
Lead capture
Nurture engagement
Sales activation
Meeting booked




Identify the most important drop-off points and develop an ongoing optimization plan to improve conversion at each stage.







Nurture Segmentation and Activation

Build tailored nurture journeys for different audience and account segments.

Create activation campaigns that move leads through the sales cycle using relevant content, timely messaging, and clear next steps.




Segmentation may include factors such as:

Institution type
Account size
Buyer persona
Engagement level
Campaign source
Funnel stage
Product interest







Webinar Planning and Execution

Own webinar campaigns from initial concept through post-event conversion.

Responsibilities include:

Topic selection
Audience definition
Registration-page messaging
Email promotion
LinkedIn promotion
Session structure
Speaker coordination
Attendee nurture
Post-event follow-up
Conversion reporting




Webinars should be managed as pipeline-generation programs rather than standalone events.







Content Amplification

Transform executive thought leadership and long-form content into coordinated campaign assets.

Repurpose content across:

Email campaigns
LinkedIn posts
Nurture sequences
Landing pages
Webinar promotions
Campaign messaging
Sales enablement assets




The objective is to maximize the reach, relevance, and commercial impact of every core content asset.







Landing-Page Creation and Optimization

Create dedicated landing pages for priority campaigns, including:

Webinars
Reports and downloadable resources
Product or solution campaigns
Account-based marketing initiatives
Lead-generation offers




Continuously improve landing-page conversion based on traffic, engagement, and conversion data.







Programmatic Display Strategy

Lead the setup and ongoing management of programmatic display campaigns.

Working alongside a GTM Engineer, you may help coordinate the synchronization of CRM contact lists into platforms such as RollWorks or Demandbase.




You will be responsible for:

Defining audience segments
Developing campaign messaging
Directing creative concepts
Coordinating campaign launches
Reviewing engagement data
Ensuring display campaigns reinforce broader GTM initiatives







Cross-Channel Campaign Alignment

Serve as the connective layer across active growth channels.




Ensure that outbound sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, company-page content, nurture tracks, webinars, landing pages, and display advertising communicate a consistent message to the same audience.




Prospects should experience one coordinated campaign across multiple touchpoints rather than a collection of disconnected marketing activities.







Performance Analysis and Feedback Loops

Review campaign performance weekly using available analytics dashboards and CRM insights.

You will be expected to:

Interpret campaign and funnel data
Identify patterns and conversion opportunities
Scale successful campaigns
Adjust underperforming campaigns
Recommend when campaigns should be discontinued
Translate findings into the next campaign cycle




Every campaign should generate learnings that improve future execution.







Required Experience

Demonstrated experience in B2B growth marketing
Experience working with SaaS companies
Experience marketing to banks, credit unions, financial institutions, or similar financial-services audiences
Strong understanding of B2B campaign strategy and demand generation
Experience building and optimizing multi-channel campaigns
Experience with email marketing, nurture programs, webinars, landing pages, and content distribution
Strong understanding of funnel analytics and conversion optimization
Experience developing messaging for complex products and senior business audiences
Ability to work independently in a fractional or consulting environment
Strong written and verbal English communication skills







Preferred Experience

Experience using HubSpot
Experience with account-based marketing
Familiarity with RollWorks, Demandbase, or similar ABM platforms
Experience collaborating with GTM Engineers, sales teams, executives, and content specialists
Experience marketing technology or software solutions to regulated industries
Familiarity with AI-assisted marketing and campaign analysis
Experience working with U.S.-based companies and stakeholders







What Success Looks Like

Within the first phase of the engagement, the Growth Marketer should be able to:

Complete a structured funnel and campaign audit
Establish clear campaign hypotheses and performance benchmarks
Improve alignment across active marketing channels
Launch or optimize segmented nurture journeys
Introduce a consistent A/B testing process
Develop a measurable webinar and content-amplification engine
Identify the highest-impact conversion opportunities
Establish a weekly campaign feedback loop




Longer-term success will be measured through improvements in engagement, conversion rates, qualified pipeline creation, meeting generation, and the overall efficiency of the growth system.







Engagement Details

Role: Fractional Growth Marketer
Engagement Type: Independent contractor
Commitment: Approximately 20 hours per week
Location: Remote
Client Market: United States
Industry: B2B SaaS and financial services technology
Hourly Rate: $28–$42 USD, depending on experience, specialization, and demonstrated capabilities

A practical campaign or growth-marketing exercise
A video interview with the ATQLeads team
A final client-engagement review




Applicants may also be evaluated for inclusion in the broader ATQ Certified Operator Network and considered for future ATQLeads client engagements.

description:

Sobre Hellotext

Hellotext es inteligencia autónoma para ecommerce. Lee las señales de una tienda, decide la mejor acción para cada cliente y la ejecuta por WhatsApp y otros canales. Somos un equipo, creciendo rápidamente.




El rol

Buscamos una persona senior y muy hands-on que pueda transformar nuestro producto, datos de clientes y calendario de lanzamientos en mensajes claros y materiales de marketing de alta calidad.




Trabajarás directamente con el founder, quien inicialmente seguirá definiendo la estrategia, las prioridades y el roadmap de lanzamientos. Tu responsabilidad será convertir esas decisiones en contenido concreto, coherente y publicado.




No buscamos una capa intermedia cuya función principal sea coordinar personas. Buscamos a alguien que escriba personalmente, tenga excelente criterio editorial y pueda llevar cada pieza desde la investigación hasta su publicación.




Qué vas a hacer

Entender profundamente el producto, los clientes, el mercado y los casos de uso de Hellotext.
Crear la narrativa, el mensaje principal y los materiales necesarios para cada lanzamiento.
Escribir y editar personalmente el copy del sitio, landing pages y páginas de producto.

Mantener un calendario editorial conectado con el roadmap de producto y los lanzamientos.
Preparar briefs claros para diseño, motion, SEO y otros especialistas.
Revisar que cada pieza mantenga la narrativa, el nivel de calidad y los objetivos definidos.
Analizar el desempeño del contenido y proponer mejoras basadas en resultados.




Qué no es este rol

No es un puesto de coordinación general sin producción propia.
No requiere diseñar, producir motion o editar videos personalmente.
No requiere ejecutar SEO técnico ni administrar campañas de paid media.
No requiere desarrollar o implementar el sitio.
No implica definir de forma independiente la estrategia de la compañía o del producto.
No es un puesto de gestión de un equipo grande.




Contarás con especialistas para diseño, SEO, paid media y otras necesidades específicas. El equipo actual de Producto e Ingeniería se encargará de la implementación técnica del sitio y la instrumentación.




Qué buscamos

Al menos tres años de experiencia escribiendo personalmente contenido para compañías B2B SaaS, ya sea internamente o desde una agencia.
Un portafolio sólido con materiales que realmente hayas escrito.
Excelente escritura y edición en español.
Capacidad profesional para trabajar con documentación y conversaciones en inglés.
Experiencia creando páginas de producto, anuncios, newsletters, artículos, guías o casos de clientes.
Capacidad para comprender productos complejos y explicarlos de forma clara, concreta y convincente.
Buen criterio para distinguir una idea interesante de contenido genérico.
Autonomía para investigar, entrevistar fuentes, escribir, revisar y publicar.
Residencia actual en Latinoamérica y disponibilidad para trabajar a tiempo completo.




Es especialmente valiosa la experiencia en ecommerce, CRM, lifecycle marketing, automatización, productos de datos o inteligencia artificial.




Cómo se verá un buen trabajo

Cada lanzamiento tendrá una narrativa clara y los materiales adecuados para cada canal.
El sitio, los anuncios, los contenidos y las comunicaciones compartirán un mensaje coherente.
Los materiales se publicarán con calidad y dentro de los plazos acordados.
El contenido estará sustentado en producto real, datos, clientes y resultados.
Aprenderemos de lo publicado y ajustaremos formatos, mensajes y canales de acuerdo con su desempeño.




Cómo postularte

Adjunta un único PDF en LinkedIn:

Las primeras páginas deben contener tu CV.
La última página debe incluir enlaces a por lo menos tres piezas que hayas escrito personalmente.
Para cada pieza, indica brevemente cuál fue tu contribución exacta.
Incluye, si es posible, una página de producto o lanzamiento, un artículo, guía o caso de cliente, y una comunicación como newsletter o anuncio.




Si LinkedIn agrega automáticamente un CV anterior, reemplázalo por esta versión combinada.

Las personas finalistas podrán ser invitadas a realizar un ejercicio breve, remunerado y con tiempo limitado, utilizando material anonimizado de Hellotext.

Esta NO es una posición de soporte reactivo ni de telemarketing masivo. Es un rol de gestión estratégica de cartera, donde serás responsable de analizar datos de consumo, identificar oportunidades de negocio y ejecutar llamadas estratégicas outbound para fidelizar, reactivar cuentas inactivas y cerrar ventas consultivas de insumos médicos con especialistas y administradores hospitalarios.

Responsabilidades Principales


Prospección y Reactivación Outbound: Realizar contacto directo y llamadas estratégicas a cuentas inactivas o con potencial de recompra para identificar necesidades y cerrar ventas consultivas.
Gestión Data-Driven: Analizar y segmentar la cartera de clientes bajo metodologías RFM (Recencia, Frecuencia, Valor Monetario) para priorizar el esfuerzo comercial.
Gestión Omnicanal: Administrar y dar seguimiento oportuno a leads y chats de venta mediante plataformas de automatización (Treble) y sistemas CRM/ERP.
Venta Cruzada y Fidelización: Negociar con médicos y tomadores de decisión en hospitales para asegurar la recompra de consumibles y tecnología médica.


Requisitos


Experiencia: Mínimo 1 a 2 años en roles como Especialista de Retención Outbound o Customer Success Comercial, Telemarketing -Venta cruzada y atención a clientes.
Habilidades Comerciales: Capacidad demostrada para realizar prospección/contacto telefónico B2B de alto nivel, negociación consultiva y manejo de objeciones.
Herramientas Tecnológicas: Manejo fluido de ERP/CRM avanzados (Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot) y herramientas conversacionales/automatización.
Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidad para trabajar con volúmenes de datos, cotizaciones y métricas de seguimiento.


Ofrecemos


Sueldo base competitivo.
Atractivo esquema de comisiones y bonos de alto rendimiento.
Capacitación especializada en tecnología médica y desarrollo profesional.
Estabilidad en un sector de alta demanda y crecimiento.
Zona de trabajo: Colonia del Valle.

description:
About the job

About Us

PHINIA: Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.

PHINIA is an independent, market-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGE™. With over 12,500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.

At PHINIA, we Provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality — developed and manufactured responsibly — that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards.

Our Culture 

PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously.

Career Opportunities 

We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow.

Job Purpose

Ensure customer orders are accurate and serve as the primary point of contact for customers regarding order status communication, order-related issues, and timely delivery.

Key Responsibilities


Receive customer information and update orders accurately and in a timely manner in accordance with delivery policies. 
Communicate customer requirements to the Production Control department on the customer's behalf. 
Request the timely shipment of available finished goods inventory. 
Provide customers with timely feedback regarding the status of their orders. 
Enter, cancel, and expedite orders. 
Act as the company's official representative in maintaining effective communication and a positive working relationship with all customers, continuously striving to improve those relationships. 
Keep Management informed of existing or potential issues that could prevent the timely delivery of customer orders. 
Actively participate in the Annual Physical Inventory. 


What We’re Looking For


Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, International Business, Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 
Experience: One year or more of experience in a similar position. 
Technical Knowledge Required: Knowledge of manufacturing processes. 
Other Requirements: Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP systems. 
English Level: Proficient. 


What We Offer

We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well-being resources, family-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value.

We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed.

What We Believe


Product Leadership - Innovation that brings value to our customers 
Humility - Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively 
Inclusivity - Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional 
Net-Zero - Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse 
Integrity - Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right 
Accountability - Taking ownership of our actions and driving results


SAFETY

You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!

We also believe employee health and safety is everyone’s responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

VISA SPONSORSHIP

PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based.

NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS FROM RECRUITERS & VENDORS

Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received.

GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT

Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.

Please access the linked document by clicking here, select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review.

Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.

Career Scam Disclaimer: 

PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities.

Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www.phinia.com.

description:
About the job

About Us

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.




The Opportunity

We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Advertising Sales Coordinator to join Skift and drive the day-to-day execution of our sales operations. This role is ideal for an operational professional who thrives on owning repeatable processes and ensuring digital systems run flawlessly. You will take charge of contracts, CRM data, lead management, and pipeline support, building a deep familiarity with Skift's sales engine. If you are a proactive problem-solver looking for a role with a clear path toward greater ownership over time, this is your moment. We are looking for candidates based in LATAM.




Why This Role Matters

Reporting to the Sales Operations Manager, you are the operational backbone of Skift’s Branded Sales team. By owning the day-to-day execution of contracts, lead management, and CRM administration, you free up leadership to focus on high-level strategy, systems, and cross-functional governance. Working closely with Sales, Studio, Product, and Finance, your meticulous attention to detail ensures that our commercial engine runs smoothly, discrepancies are caught early, and revenue is tracked accurately.




Some of What You’ll Do

Contract Administration & Deal Execution

Generate standard sponsorship agreements, insertion orders, and order forms using approved templates, ensuring all information is complete and consistent.
Manage the full signature routing process, follow up on outstanding agreements, and ensure executed documents are properly saved in the contract repository.
Update deal status across HubSpot, Actuals, and prospect trackers, proactively escalating redlines or complex nonstandard terms to the Sales Operations Manager.

CRM & Lead Management

Maintain impeccable data hygiene in HubSpot by completing routine updates, data cleanup, deduplication, and quality checks.
Review and vet inbound leads, assign them to the appropriate sales representatives, and maintain trackers to monitor response status and conversion rates.
Flag high-value, unclear, or suspicious inquiries, and assist with targeted prospect and audience list development.

Pipeline & Digital Campaign Support

Reconcile routine discrepancies between contracts, HubSpot, and internal trackers, actively monitoring deals as they move from verbal agreement to closed-won.
Prepare accurate data for monthly revenue reconciliation, recurring pacing, and campaign reports.
Support digital campaign execution by assisting with creative collection, quality assurance, and proof-of-performance reporting for newsletter and podcast sponsorships.

Process Documentation & Cross-Team Coordination

Document recurring workflows, update instructions as processes evolve, and support the onboarding of new team members.
Coordinate routine operational requests across Sales, Studio, and Finance, constantly identifying repetitive tasks or process gaps that can be improved.




What You’ll Bring

1–3 years of experience in sales coordination, sales operations, or a similar administrative support role.
CRM Fluency: Hands-on experience working in a CRM (HubSpot is highly preferred), with a strong grasp of data cleanup, pipeline management, and lead routing.
Operational Rigor: Exceptional attention to detail and strong spreadsheet skills, allowing you to manage multiple deadlines, complex workflows, and detail-heavy business records simultaneously.
Proactive Communication: Clear written and professional follow-up skills. You are comfortable communicating with clients, recognize when to escalate an issue, and never let details paralyze your execution.
Adaptability: A calm demeanor when priorities shift, a receptiveness to feedback, and the ability to learn systems quickly in a remote work environment.
Bonus: Experience with PandaDoc (or similar e-signature platforms), familiarity with commercial tools (Apollo, Basecamp), or prior exposure to sponsored content, media, and digital advertising.




Success Metrics

Operational Accuracy: Contracts, CRM updates, and lead management are handled accurately, on time, and with pristine attention to detail.
Process Autonomy: Reliable, independent execution of daily sales ops tasks and workflows within the first 6–12 months.
Proactive Problem Solving: Errors, discrepancies, and missing data are caught early and escalated appropriately before they impact the pipeline or billing.
Seamless Collaboration: The establishment of strong, trusted working relationships across the Sales, Studio, Product, and Finance teams.




What We Offer

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.
Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence.
Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment.




How We Work

Skift's culture is diverse, cohesive, and full of people who love what they do and bring the best of themselves to work. We are remote but very connected and caring about each other.




How To Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. PLEASE SEND US A COVER LETTER ALONG WITH YOUR RESUME sharing why you’re interested and how your experience aligns with Skift's mission.

Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world. We welcome applicants from all life experiences and encourage members of traditionally underrepresented backgrounds to apply.




Here’s what you can expect next

If selected to interview, a Skift team member will reach out to schedule next steps.

About the job

About the job

At Jellyfish we believe that our individual differences are our greatest assets. We are passionate about empowering every employee to reach their full potential and contribute their unique perspectives to our collaborative environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and firmly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce drives innovation and leads to better solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other personal characteristics that make them who they are.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

We are seeking a systems-oriented creative production expert who excels at building and troubleshooting HTML5 display ads but is even more passionate about revolutionizing creative workflows.

In the role of Creative Technologist, you will spearhead the transformation of HTML5 display production by implementing AI-enhanced workflows and automated, scalable systems. Collaborating with creative, strategy, media, and development teams, you will convert campaign goals into efficient production frameworks. Your influence will span the entire lifecycle, defining how briefs, prompts, feeds, and variants integrate with rigorous QA and approval steps.

Responsibilities


Architect, evaluate, and refine AI-powered production workflows for creative adaptation and digital display.
Oversee the development and adaptation of HTML5 ads and creative materials, using tools such as GSAP and Google Web Designer. Ensure all assets are resized, optimised, and delivered on time to meet the needs of the campaign.
Manage the process of creating and optimising dynamic creative content for large-scale campaigns, using platforms like Flashtalking, Celtra, and Google Creative Studio.
Strategically map the production lifecycle from initial brief to final delivery, pinpointing opportunities to enhance operational velocity, consistency, and creative scalability through advanced automation, structured data inputs, and superior tooling.
Work closely with design, development, and media teams to ensure a seamless production process, providing clear guidance and feedback to ensure the highest quality outputs.
Ensure all deliverables meet high standards of quality and functionality.
Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and new platforms relevant to digital ad production and creative technology.
Manage the preparation and localization of assets, ensuring that creative assets are appropriately adapted for different markets and channels


Qualifications


5+ years of experience in digital production, creative technology, or similar roles, with a strong focus on digital ad development and optimization.
Demonstrable curiosity and applied knowledge of generative AI within creative ecosystems, specifically focusing on agentic methodologies, nodal architectures, and the deployment of automated, interconnected production tooling.
Solid understanding of DCO (Dynamic Creative Optimization), including working with dynamic feeds, creative updates, and tools like Google Creative Studio and Ads Creative Studio.
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, with experience in hand-coding interactive and animated display ads.
Strong skills in Adobe Suite (After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator), Figma, and 3D software (Blender is a bonus).
Experience with AI-powered platforms
Excellent project management skills with experience balancing multiple projects and deadlines.
Advanced English


Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Savings fund: You'll save 5% of your monthly income and Jellyfish will contribute the same amount you save to your savings fund.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

🏥 Health Insurance: We provide a private health insurance policy that includes visual and dental plan coverage.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to talentacquisition@jellyfish.com.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

About the job

¿Sabes cómo crecer un mercado desde cero, conoces el ecosistema Pyme y contable mexicano, y usas IA para mover más rápido que cualquier playbook global? Este reto es para ti. 👇

Sobre nosotros 🚀

Somos el ecosistema de soluciones contables y financieras en la nube que le da superpoderes a las Pymes de Latinoamérica. +500 personas trabajando 100% remoto, presentes en 8 países y creciendo.

Hoy la inteligencia artificial atraviesa todo lo que hacemos: desde cómo construimos producto hasta cómo tomamos decisiones internas. No es un proyecto paralelo, es la forma en que operamos.

Tu misión en Alegra

Liderarás la estrategia de adquisición y activación de Alegra en México para los tres ICPs prioritarios: Pymes con necesidad de facturación, contadores, y Pymes medianas. Tu trabajo es garantizar el crecimiento de Sign Ups, MQLs, New Logos y MRR en el mercado mexicano — con IA integrada como palanca central de productividad, personalización y escala. No ejecutarás campañas globales adaptadas; construirás el ecosistema de canales y alianzas locales que Alegra necesita para crecer en México de forma sostenible.

¿Qué harás con nosotros?


Diseñar la estrategia de crecimiento por ICP en México, usando IA para modelar escenarios, priorizar canales y anticipar comportamientos de activación y churn.

Diseñar y ejecutar experimentos de crecimiento con ciclos cortos de aprendizaje, usando IA para analizar resultados, detectar patrones y proponer iteraciones antes del reporte mensual.
Activar el ecosistema de partners locales (contadores, consultores, integradores, gremios) y diseñar programas de referidos que operen con automatización e IA desde el día uno.
Gestionar el presupuesto de crecimiento asignado a México con criterio de eficiencia, proyectando CAC, LTV y retorno por canal con modelos de IA.
Coordinar con los equipos de Performance, Content y Brand las iniciativas tácticas del país, usando IA para acelerar la producción, el testing y la optimización de campañas.
Colaborar con Ventas, Producto y Customer Success para asegurar coherencia en la experiencia de adquisición y activación, identificando los friction points más críticos del funnel.
Representar a Alegra en eventos, comunidades y espacios de influencia relevantes para Pymes y contadores en México.


¿Cómo usarás IA en el día a día?


Investigarás el mercado mexicano y generarás hipótesis de crecimiento con modelos de lenguaje antes de cada ciclo de estrategia, sin esperar al analista ni al siguiente reporte.
Producirás variantes de mensajes por ICP con IA, reduciendo la dependencia del equipo de contenido para cada iteración de campaña o canal.
Construirás flujos automatizados para el programa de partners y referidos usando herramientas como n8n, Zapier o Make, con IA integrada desde el diseño. El stack específico es flexible; la profundidad de uso no lo es.

En nuestro proceso de selección utilizamos herramientas de inteligencia artificial para realizar un prefiltrado de perfiles. reclutamiento.mx@inetum.com

Descripción del empleo

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with a solid statistical background and

practical experience in data science projects in business environments. The

candidate must be able to frame complex problems as modeling problems,

execute rigorous research cycles, and deliver reproducible solutions that can be

integrated by engineering teams.

This role operates in close collaboration with an ML Engineering team. The

candidate is expected to have clear judgment about their responsibilities within

that ecosystem and the discipline to work with software engineering standards,

not just analysis standards.

Requisitos

What We Are Looking For

Technical Fundamentals

Advanced mastery of Python as the primary and sole development language.

Solid knowledge of data science and ML libraries: Scikit-Learn , XGBoost ,

LightGBM , Pandas , Polars , Statsmodels , SciPy .

Experience with deep learning models ( TensorFlow or PyTorch ) when the

problem justifies it.

Ability to work with data at scale: advanced SQL, PySpark for exploration

and transformation.

Access to and handling of data in cloud environments (GCS, Azure Blob

Storage).

Statistical Rigor

Experimental design and hypothesis testing applied to business problems.

Understanding of causality: not just correlation but the ability to distinguish and

apply appropriate techniques.

Robust model validation: beyond accuracy, business metrics, bias analysis, and

subgroup behavior.

Development Discipline

Professional use of Git as part of the usual workflow, not as a formality at

delivery time.

Organized and modular Python code: the candidate must produce deliverable

code, not just exploration notebooks.

Familiarity with experiment tracking tools (MLflow or equivalent) for

experiment traceability.

Ability to document models in a structured way: what it solves, with what data,

with what limitations.

Experience working under team standards: secure credential handling, data

versioning, project structure.

Judgment on AI

Responsible use of generative AI tools as assistants: with the critical ability to

review and validate what they produce.

Judgment to evaluate when agent systems or LLMs are the right tool and when

they are not.

Recommended Experience

Notes for the Search

The selection process includes a practical technical evaluation and review

of the candidate’s previous work.

Reasoning ability and judgment will be valued over code production speed.

We are not looking for profiles who use tools without understanding them: we

are looking for candidates who can justify their technical and statistical

decisions.

The candidate will work under engineering standards defined by the team —

willingness and ability to adopt them from the start of any project is expected.

More than 5 years in data science, statistical analysis, or applied research roles.

Documentable end-to-end projects: from problem definition to delivery of a

validated model.

Experience working with engineering teams (ML Engineers, Data Engineers) in

agile environments.

Work history in real code repositories (a shareable portfolio will be valued).

Academic Background

Master’s or Doctoral degree in: Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science,

Physics, Computer Science, or related fields.

Experience in academic or applied research is a differentiator.
